basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Applications are invited for a walk-in interview for the post of Project Research Scientist - 1 under the project titled "Understanding the host metabolome to formulate effective diagnostics against dengue virus infection" at the Department of Biosciences and Bioengineering, Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, with a total amount of Rs. 68450.00 per month for a duration of 05 months. Interested and eligible candidates must apply online through the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati, and appear for the walk-in interview scheduled on 5th November 2026 at 10.00 a

how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates should apply online by visiting the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati (https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/).
Applicants must carefully follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.
The relevant position can be accessed by searching for the project title as mentioned in this advertisement.
Candidates are also required to appear for a Walk-in Interview scheduled on 5th November 2026 (Thursday) at 10:00 AM.
important_instructions: No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the test and interview. For any clarification, contact: Sachin Kumar (Principal Investigator), Email: [email protected], Phone: 03612582229. For any technical assistance related to the online application process, candidates may email to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About IIT Guwahati Project Research Scientist I
content_sections.text: This recruitment is conducted by the Research and Development Section at the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, located in Guwahati-781039, Assam. The selected candidate will be appointed for a duration of 05 months in the Department of Biosciences and Bioengineering for a research project entitled "Understanding the host metabolome to formulate effective diagnostics against dengue virus infection" under the contact of Sachin Kumar (Principal Investigator).

content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a pay recommended of Rs. 56000, along with HRA of Rs. 11200 and Medical of Rs. 1250, making a total amount of Rs. 68450.00. The duration of the appointment in months is 05.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the Walk-in interview. Candidates will not be sent any call letter separately.
